newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open lower, hurt by Nissan Life.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open lower, hurt by Nissan Life.

text.p: Tokyo stocks slid in early morning trade on Friday as worries over Japanese firms' financial health were rekindled by media reports that the Ministry of Finance was preparing to issue an order to halt operations of Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co, brokers said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average fell 107.21 points or 0.57 percent to 18,590.86 in the first 10 minutes of trade. Its June futures slipped 120 points to 18,580.
A little after the market opened, the Finance Ministry said it had ordered Nissan Life to halt operations.
